g.text: Latency scaling — NVIDIA A10G CUDA and llvmpipe CPU

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: CUDA: allocating calls, 45 samples / 20 warmups; bands: IQR; hollow markers: repeat. wgpu CPU: preallocated calls, 5 samples / 2 warmups; no IQR recorded.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: All calls include synchronization. Attention wgpu curves connect only equal B/H profiles. Workloads/devices differ; bottom ratios are CUDA only. No autotuning.
